_about: Documents the Kenya Debt Counter's debt sustainability thresholds and related figures rest on. watch/check_reports.py checks every week that each one can still be found (and records which link worked), and opens an issue if a link disappears. Every source_url in the sheet's dsa_thresholds tab is checked the same way. Add a document here whenever the site or the report starts relying on it. 'urls' are tried in order; 'confirmed': false means the link is a likely address that has not been checked by hand yet.
